summary: The group holds 132 rows (odm_a 6, system_a 65, system_ext_a 7, vendor_a 54; 130 regular files and 2 symlinks) that make up the Android display, graphics-composition and DRM stack of a Qualcomm SDM/SDE-based device with Oculus VR (VROS) components. Two IComposer 2.4 HAL implementations are registered in VINTF: the Qualcomm vendor.qti.hardware.display.composer-service (IQtiComposer 3.2, DisplayConfig AIDL) and the Oculus StrataComposer service (instance "display", disabled at boot and enabled only when a persist.device_config property is true). surfaceflinger is the HIDL client of both, and gralloc, mapper, allocator and DisplayConfig client libraries sit beneath them. Display tuning comes from /system/etc/display.conf (JSON), /vendor/etc/display/DPU930.xml (Qualcomm SDE930 parameter table, read by libdisplayqos.so) and the vendor property vendor.display.*. About 70 rows are DRM and media-DRM material (ClearKey and Widevine HAL services, DRM framework, MediaDrm metrics, forward-lock engine, memtrack). libdrm.so here is the userspace kernel-DRM library, not Android content-protection DRM.
